narratives.Description: removeEvaluatorWorktree keeps operation-scoped registration ownership across both prune passes. A previously excluded case-distinct sibling is never promoted into the target after the first pass deletes the selected registration.
narratives.Overview: Prefer-A Bound Recut-2 6256420554 for worktrees-probe case-distinct sibling ownership.
narratives.Labels: bug, test-debt, urgent, design-critique:ingest-ready, core-capabilities, promise:swarm
narratives.UserStory: As a CI maintainer, I want worktrees-probe unregister to keep its selected admin registration across both prune passes, so that a case-distinct sibling is never deleted by fold-match after the first pass.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Select intended admin from initial inventory and retain across both passes.
2. Confirm Git remove argv and fallback deletion only target the selected registration.
3. Dual-to-single transition regression; suite-local probe cache reset.
4. CHANGELOG Unreleased Fixed for #5735.
